cypher:
MATCH (p:WindFarm)<-[:INSTALLED_AT]-(t:WindTurbine)
RETURN p.name AS windFarm, count(t) AS turbines
ORDER BY turbines DESC
LIMIT 50

MATCH (c:Company)<-[:OPERATED_BY]-(p:Plant)
RETURN c.name AS company, sum(p.installedCapacityMW) AS totalCapacityMW
ORDER BY totalCapacityMW DESC
LIMIT 50

MATCH (t:WindTurbine)
WHERE t.model CONTAINS 'Vestas' AND t.stateOfHealth < 80
RETURN t.name AS turbine, t.model AS model, t.stateOfHealth AS stateOfHealth
ORDER BY stateOfHealth
LIMIT 50

MATCH (c:Company {name: 'Захід ВДЕ'})<-[:EMPLOYED_BY]-(e:Employee)<-[:PERFORMED_BY]-(w:MaintenanceWork)
RETURN e.name AS employee, count(w) AS works
ORDER BY works DESC
LIMIT 50

MATCH (m:Measurement)-[:MEASURED_BY]->(s:TemperatureSensor)-[:OBSERVES]->(t:WindTurbine)
RETURN t.name AS turbine, max(m.value) AS maxTemperature
ORDER BY maxTemperature DESC
LIMIT 50

MATCH (ev:Event)-[:AFFECTS]->(e:Equipment)-[:INSTALLED_AT]->(p:Plant {name: 'ВЕС «Ужоцька»'})
RETURN ev.kind AS eventType, count(ev) AS events
ORDER BY events DESC
LIMIT 50

MATCH (w:MaintenanceWork)-[:USES_PART]->(sp:SparePart {name: 'Фільтр мастила'})
MATCH (w)-[:TARGETS]->(e:Equipment)
RETURN w.name AS work, e.name AS equipment
LIMIT 50

MATCH (f:Forecast)-[:FORECAST_FOR]->(p:Plant)
WHERE f.forecastDate = date('2026-11-11')
RETURN p.name AS plant, f.forecastMWh AS forecastMWh
ORDER BY plant
LIMIT 50

MATCH (r:ControlRule)-[:CONTROLS]->(e:Equipment)
RETURN r.name AS rule, count(e) AS equipmentCount
ORDER BY equipmentCount DESC
LIMIT 50

MATCH (f:FailureEvent)
OPTIONAL MATCH (f)-[:DOCUMENTED_IN]->(r:Record)
WITH f, r
WHERE r IS NULL
RETURN f.id AS failure, f.name AS name
LIMIT 50

MATCH (s:Substation {name: 'Львів-Західна'})<-[:DEPENDS_ON*1..5]-(e:Equipment)
RETURN DISTINCT e.name AS equipment, e.kind AS kind
LIMIT 50

MATCH (p:Plant)-[:LOCATED_IN]->(r:Region {name: 'Закарпатська область'})
RETURN p.name AS plant
LIMIT 50
